one_liner: Trae Young records 11.3 assists per 36 minutes -- the highest playmaking rate in this marquee set -- on 42.1 percent shooting.
three_things: 11.3 assists per 36 is the number the rest of the profile bends around.
The efficiency cost is visible: 42.1 percent from the field, 35.2 percent from three.
The line is his equalizer at 86.4 percent.
context_note: Per-36-minute rates over a 3-season sample (seasons_played: 3), not per-game and not full-career figures. The manifest is descriptive_only: no adjustment for opponent, teammates, role, or shot difficulty, and a career_min_minutes>=800 inclusion floor applies. Games and minutes measure availability, not how well those minutes were used. Assist rate is a raw box-score count with no adjustment for teammate finishing or usage; the comparison is scoped to the players with insight files in this set.
